title: Is the NASDAQ cooked?
speaker: Peter Reznicek

macro_themes.view: XLK has lost its uptrend from late July, semis are near a trend break and DRAM stocks have rolled over, weighing on the Nasdaq.

calls.condition: If QQQ breaks its uptrend line, likely drops to at least the middle of the balance area, if not lower.
calls.reason: QQQ has dropped below key levels to its trendline; XLK uptrend already broken and semis/DRAM rolling over.
calls.quote: If you break trend, you're probably going to go here, somewhere at least to the middle of the balance area if not lower.

calls.reason: SPY holding up better than the Qs; more neutral than bullish.
calls.quote: Spy, I would say looks a little bit more bullish. Maybe not more bullish, more neutral.

calls.reason: Strong downside momentum into the trendline; break looks imminent.
calls.quote: you haven't broken trend yet in the semis, but it's imminent

calls.reason: Big rollover with all trends broken; expects a move down to prior lows.
calls.quote: I believe it could easily go lower because you're going to probably come down to this these prior lows
